about:
NCAB Group USA operates from Hampstead, New Hampshire, as part of the global NCAB Group founded in 1993. The company began as a PCB supplier and has grown into a network spanning 19 countries across Europe, Asia, and North America, with customers in approximately 45 countries.

The firm manages printed circuit board production from design through series manufacturing, leveraging a vetted network of 35 partner factories. Its portfolio covers multilayer, flexible, rigid-flex, semi-flex, IMS, RF, and HDI boards. In 2025 the group reported 381 million USD in revenue and produced 271 million PCBs annually, supported by 660 specialists worldwide.

NCAB serves OEM, ODM, and EMS customers in aerospace, automotive, datacom, defense, industrial, medical, power/energy, railway, safety-critical, and telecom sectors. The company emphasizes close collaboration from the design phase to ensure reliability for demanding applications.

NCAB’s stated mission is to deliver PCBs on time with zero defects, produced sustainably at the lowest total cost. It positions itself as taking full responsibility for the PCB lifecycle, aiming to make customers more resilient, agile, and sustainable through supply-chain competence and delivery accuracy.
